description: Defines the intra_slice_scheduler class responsible for scheduling user equipment (UE) in intra-slice scenarios within a 5G/4G network, including methods for slot indication, post-processing, and scheduling UL/DL grants.

classes.name: intra_slice_scheduler
classes.description: Main class for intra-slice user equipment scheduling, managing slot indications, scheduling policies, and resource allocation.

classes.name: slice_ue_group_scheduler
classes.description: Inner struct managing UE groups for DL and UL scheduling within intra_slice_scheduler.

methods.name: intra_slice_scheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the scheduler with configuration, resource allocators, and logger.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Resets or updates scheduler state at the start of a new slot.

methods.name: post_process_results
methods.description: Finalizes scheduling results after grants are allocated.

methods.name: dl_sched
methods.description: Schedules downlink grants for a specific slice.

methods.name: ul_sched
methods.description: Schedules uplink grants for a specific slice.

methods.name: can_allocate_pdsch
methods.description: Checks if a UE can be scheduled for downlink in the current slot.

methods.name: can_allocate_pusch
methods.description: Checks if a UE can be scheduled for uplink in the current slot.

methods.name: create_newtx_dl_candidate
methods.description: Creates a new downlink transmission candidate for a UE.

methods.name: create_newtx_ul_candidate
methods.description: Creates a new uplink transmission candidate for a UE.

methods.name: prepare_newtx_dl_candidates
methods.description: Prepares downlink transmission candidates for scheduling.

methods.name: prepare_newtx_ul_candidates
methods.description: Prepares uplink transmission candidates for scheduling.

methods.name: schedule_dl_newtx_candidates
methods.description: Schedules new transmission candidates for downlink.

methods.name: schedule_ul_newtx_candidates
methods.description: Schedules new transmission candidates for uplink.

methods.name: max_pdschs_to_alloc
methods.description: Calculates maximum downlink resource blocks to allocate.

methods.name: max_puschs_to_alloc
methods.description: Calculates maximum uplink resource blocks to allocate.

methods.name: update_used_dl_vrbs
methods.description: Updates the bitmap of used downlink resource blocks.

methods.name: update_used_ul_vrbs
methods.description: Updates the bitmap of used uplink resource blocks.
